item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Texas judge denies Karmelo Anthony's request for new trial in deadly stabbing at track meet
item.description: DALLAS (AP) — A Texas judge denied a new trial for Karmelo Anthony on Saturday in the stabbing death of a 17-year-old athlete at a high school track meet, a killing that drew national attention and led to harassment of the families. Anthony, 19, was convicted of murder in June and sentenced to 35 years [...]
